reasons.correctness: createTicket publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent through ApplicationEventPublisher. The listener's @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) sends via sendTicketCreationConfirmation. Interface names match. Build green, hidden tests 3/3, existing tests 54/54.
reasons.convention_fit: Event and listener sit in the support/ticket/event feature package. The listener uses @RequiredArgsConstructor with a final field and catches and logs its own failures. The service's constructor got the new parameter. Unit tests were added and run with -Ptest.
reasons.design_fit: Copies the InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener structure. EmailService stays injected because addAdminResponse still uses it. Minimal footprint, no duplicated logic, no new mechanism. The integration test was adapted rather than deleted.
reasons.test_quality: The listener unit test pins the argument mapping and the swallowed exception. The service unit test captures the event and asserts its fields plus verifyNoInteractions(emailService). The language field is not asserted, and there is no test of a rollback path.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the ticket files, existing Event/EventListener examples (InvoiceCreatedEventListener) and TESTED_BY dependents of SupportTicketService before editing. The edits followed that exemplar and updated those tests.
